description: The bar chart compares the performance of two different critic models, Flan-T5-783M and GPT-4, across various tasks. The horizontal axis lists the tasks, which include TriviaQA (EM), HotPotQA (EM), 2Wiki (EM), TriviaQA (F1), HotPotQA (F1), and 2Wiki (F1). The vertical axis represents the performance score, ranging from 0 to 85. The blue bars represent the performance of Flan-T5-783M, while the red bars represent the performance of GPT-4. The highest score is achieved by Flan-T5-783M in TriviaQA (EM) with a score of 82.8, closely followed by GPT-4 with a score of 83.8. The lowest score is achieved by GPT-4 in 2Wiki (EM) with a score of 31.9. The chart shows that Flan-T5-783M generally performs better than GPT-4 across the tasks, with the exception of HotPotQA (EM) where GPT-4 scores slightly higher.
